issues_detected.description: Every release record carries created_on '2025-02-27T00:00:00Z' including the June 2026 release (issued 2026-06-17 per distribution_dates) and the October 2025 release, while file-level issued dates inside the June 2025 release (F3TD5R) are '2025-10-22', later than that release's issued '2025-07-01'. The dates are plausibly Dataverse creation/revision timestamps, but they are not explained and read as a temporal inconsistency.
issues_detected.recommendation: State what created_on records (Dataverse dataset creation vs. release publication) or drop it; annotate the 2025-10-22 file dates as the revision date of the June 2025 release.

issues_detected.description: regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level 'unrestricted' alongside confidential_elements.confidential_elements_present true for embargoed perturb-seq deposits. The released files are public, so the level is defensible, but the embargoed deposits are part of the described release series.
issues_detected.recommendation: Qualify the confidentiality level as applying to released files and state the expected embargo lift for the perturb-seq deposits.

issues_detected.description: preprocessing_strategies, labeling_strategies and machine_annotation_tools describe the MuSIC cell-map pipeline and GPT-4 assembly naming, yet the record states computed cell maps 'are not included in these releases'. The processing actually applied to the released raw data (image acquisition/QC, MS search and quantification, perturb-seq count processing) is not described.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add preprocessing entries for the released modalities (image processing and antibody QC, SEC-MS/AP-MS search software and versions, perturb-seq alignment/count pipeline) and keep the MuSIC description flagged as downstream.

issues_detected.description: raw_data_sources name repositories (MassIVE, Figshare, NCBI BioProject) with no accession identifiers, and distribution_formats[1] gives the Dataverse Data Access API as a base path 'https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/' without a datafile id.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record MassIVE (MSV...), BioProject (PRJNA...) and Figshare identifiers where the bundle gives them, and cite a concrete API example or the persistent-id form of the API.

issues_detected.description: grant '5U54HG012513-02' is the Bridge2AI Bridge Center award, not a CM4AI award; the record sources it correctly to the preprint acknowledgements but labels it under the CM4AI NIH funder without that qualification in the grant name.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a description to the U54 grant entry stating it is the program-wide Bridge Center award acknowledged by the preprint.

issues_detected.description: Structural gaps against Q1: no dataset-level doi although five release DOIs exist; variables and parent_datasets empty; no top-level version.
issues_detected.recommendation: Set doi to the current release DOI (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C) or a collection-level identifier, and populate variables from the RO-Crate JSON-Schema definitions FAIRSCAPE emits.

issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews entries carry personal email addresses of two named ethicists, and data_governance and maintainers carry three more. These are sourced from the Dataverse governance block and web pages, so are public, but they are contact details rather than review outcomes.
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep institutional/role contacts; consider omitting personal addresses from the datasheet or moving them to a single contact slot.

semantic_insights: Human-subjects logic is coherent: involves_human_subjects false, 'Human Subjects: No', no IRB asserted, de-identification explained by the cell-line source, sensitive_elements_present false and direct_collection.is_direct false all agree.

License logic is coherent: top-level license, license_and_use_terms, data_use_permission 'no_commercial_use', prohibited_uses (commercial) and ip_restrictions (dual licensing via DAC) describe one consistent CC BY-NC-SA regime.
DOI prefix 10.18130 is the University of Virginia LibraData/Dataverse registrar, matching the stated publisher (ROR:0153tk833 resolves to the University of Virginia).
NIH award strings 1OT2OD032742-01 and 5U54HG012513-02 follow the NIH application-number pattern; cell-line RRIDs CVCL_0419 and CVCL_B5P3 follow the Cellosaurus RRID pattern; ORCIDs are well-formed.

Source disagreements (release-page date 'June 17, 2025' vs Dataverse 2026-06-17; 523 vs 563/464 proteins imaged; August vs November 2026 project end) are carried in source_caveats with the manifest tiering that resolved them, rather than silently reconciled.

The Nature U2OS cell-map paper is linked but explicitly distinguished ('a distinct cell line ... computed cell maps are not included'), avoiding conflation of a related publication with the released data.

Instance and count values agree across fields: 11,739 targeted genes appears identically in description, instances, subsets and file_collections; 464/563 image protein counts are attributed to the specific releases that state them.

questions.description: How users obtain the dataset
questions.evidence: distribution_formats[0]: LibraData collection, 'Files are public', 'datasets are too large to download in one operation, so individual files must be selected', per-selection ZIP limits '953.7 MB' / '1.9 GB'; [1] 'Data Access API ... package download URL is given for use with wget or a download manager'; [2] CM4AI web portal. license_and_use_terms CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; data_governance.access_review_process 'the released files themselves are public and require no access request'; third_party_sharing.is_shared true.

questions.name: Reusability, Use Guidance, and Social Impact
questions.description: License, intended/prohibited/discouraged uses, social impact with mitigation
questions.score_label: License + comprehensive use guidance; social impact analysis general
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with usage_notes on attribution. intended_uses: 'AI model training', 'Cellular process analysis', 'Cell architectural changes ... in presence of specific disease processes, treatment conditions, or genetic perturbations'. prohibited_uses: 'not to be used in clinical decision-making or in any context involving patient care without appropriate regulatory oversight', commercial use without a separate license. future_use_impacts: 'visible' ML systems, 'ethical, explainable and interpretable biomedical AI', Ethics Module remit to 'anticipate potential applications ... and mitigate potential risks'. discouraged_uses absent.
questions.quality_note: Use guidance is clear and licence-consistent (the commercial prohibition matches the NC clause). The social impact entry is aspirational benefit plus a statement that risks are anticipated by the Ethics Module; no concrete risk (e.g. misuse of perturbation data, over-generalisation from two cell lines to patients) is identified with a specific mitigation, and discouraged_uses is empty.

questions.name: Data Integrity, Provenance Graph, and Quality
questions.description: Version access, errata, updates, derivation, parent datasets, missing data, splits, provenance graph
questions.score_label: Version history plus documented provenance graph; lineage described, not carried
questions.evidence: version_access (5 releases), errata (June 2025 revision), updates (quarterly), raw_data_sources (6 deposits), subsets.is_data_split false. Provenance: 'Outputs are packaged with provenance graphs ... in RO-Crate format using the FAIRSCAPE framework'; 'The server computes end-to-end entailments on each RO-Crate's provenance expressed in the EVI Evidence Graph Ontology'; released files include 'Images-paclitaxel-provenance-graph.html', 'mass-spec-cancer-cells-provenance-graph.html' and per-collection ro-crate-metadata.json with md5 checksums. Absent: was_derived_from, parent_datasets, missing_data_documentation.
questions.quality_note: The record documents that an entity-activity-agent provenance graph (EVI, RO-Crate) exists and is distributed with each release, and it records file-level md5 integrity values; but the D4D itself carries no derivation paths (was_derived_from/parent_datasets empty) and no missing-data documentation, and the described MuSIC lineage concerns cell maps not in the release. Full lineage is referenced rather than represented.

questions.name: Bias Documentation and Responsible AI Alignment
questions.description: Known biases with standardized taxonomy and fairness analysis
questions.score_label: Basic bias identification with enum type, no fairness analysis
questions.evidence: known_biases: one entry, bias_type 'representation_bias', 'derived from commercially available de-identified human cell lines and do not represent all biological variants which may be seen in the population at large', affected_subsets naming both cell-line groups. subpopulations gives donor sex/ancestry/age. known_limitations adds 'Incomplete overlap between modalities' and 'Interim release'. No AIO mapping, no fairness analysis.
questions.quality_note: A single, well-placed representation bias using the schema enum. Selection bias of the targeted 100+100 protein panel (documented in sampling_strategies but not classed as a bias), measurement/batch effects across sites and releases, and the two-donor demographic narrowness (one female cancer donor, one male European donor) are not enumerated as biases, and no fairness or downstream-model analysis is given.

strengths: Complete, mutually consistent governance and access documentation: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms, itemised IP restrictions, a Data Access Committee with named contact, unrestricted confidentiality matching public file access, and practical download instructions (per-selection ZIP limits, Data Access API).

Sustainability fully evidenced: five DOI-identified releases with versions, an erratum, a quarterly update plan, named maintainers, and a stated long-term preservation commitment 'supported by committed institutional funds' in an NIH-approved repository.
Funding and attribution are specific and correctly formatted (1OT2OD032742-01 with RePORTER details, ORCIDs, ROR for the publisher).
Collection mechanisms are protocol-level (guide RNAs per gene, 10x kit, antibody channels, SEC-MS detection counts) and attributed to the labs that generated each modality.
Source conflicts and scope boundaries are disclosed rather than smoothed over (source_caveats on dates and protein counts; cell maps not included; embargoed deposits named).
weaknesses: Processing documentation describes the downstream MuSIC/LLM cell-map pipeline, whose outputs are not in the releases, while the processing applied to the released images, MS and perturb-seq data is undocumented.
Payload data formats inside the ZIP archives are never stated, and raw-data repository deposits lack accession identifiers.

Bias documentation is a single representation_bias entry; panel selection bias, cross-site/cross-release batch effects and the two-donor demographic narrowness are not enumerated, and there is no fairness analysis.
Social impact is aspirational with a generic mitigation statement; discouraged_uses is empty.
Dataset-level doi, variables, parent_datasets and version slots are empty; created_on dates are identical across releases and unexplained.
recommendations: Add preprocessing_strategies entries for the released modalities: image acquisition/QC software, MS search and quantification tools with versions, and the perturb-seq alignment/count pipeline.
State the file formats inside each ZIP archive (e.g. image format, MS result tables, count matrices) in file_collections and add MassIVE/BioProject/Figshare accession identifiers to raw_data_sources.

Expand known_biases with selection bias of the targeted protein panel, measurement/batch bias across production sites and releases, and donor-demographic narrowness; add a short fairness/generalisability statement.
Populate discouraged_uses (e.g. extrapolating cell-line findings to patient populations) and give future_use_impacts at least one concrete risk with its mitigation.
Set the dataset-level doi to the current release DOI, populate variables from the RO-Crate JSON-Schema definitions, and explain or remove the uniform created_on value.
